purpose: Fixed thirteen-thesis corpus, exactly as released by CCSICT, for the approved baseline-versus-RAG defense evaluation.

released_composition.note: The department released only these manuscripts and selected them itself, so the corpus is a department-determined census of the released set rather than a researcher-drawn proportional sample. Categories the department did not release are unrepresented and are recorded here so the gap is explicit. validate_manifest checks that the counts sum to expected_paper_count, that every program/specialization pair is one the catalog defines, that no pair is both represented and unrepresented, and, once the manifest is lock-ready, that papers[] matches this distribution exactly.
